release: Marble Oracle — EIDOLITH 0.4.7 — Native OS File Pickers / No News or Markets
test_environment: Ubuntu 24.04 container, Xvfb, Python 3.12.3 + Tk 8.6, FFmpeg 6.1.1 (libx264/libx265/libsvtav1 1.7.0), no GPU
media_features: Persisted fail-and-continue queue with per-job logs
asset_preservation: All original runtime media archives, fonts, Oggcultist branding, art and source modules preserved unchanged.
hash_notes: FILE_INVENTORY.json excludes itself, BUILD_MANIFEST.json and AUDIT/VERIFICATION_REPORT.md to avoid self-referential hashes.
eidolith_0_4_changes: oracle_eidolith_jobs.py queue engine (fail-and-continue, stop vs cancel, explicit retry)
per-job FFmpeg logs, diagnostics export with folder redaction
progress panel: job n of m, %, elapsed, speed, ETA, last activity, indeterminate when unknown
cover art / subtitle / attachment / data stream plan with verification
persisted queue, interrupted-job reconciliation, owned-partial cleanup
spaced-name filename parser fix (Mr. Robot case)
short output names by default; episode title and format tag opt-in
SLIM OUTPUT (video + main audio) default; Opus 5.1(side) fix
REMOVE SELECTED / CLEAR ALL queue removal
0.4.5 audit fixes: rotation, movie year, folder title, deinterlace, disk space, fetch caps, clipboard clear, default profile, .bat launcher
0.4.6: slim keep-English-subtitles / prefer-English-audio options, skip already converted
0.4.7: Turbo AV1, smart copy of compact AV1/HEVC, hardware test encode, QSV/AMF HEVC profiles (unverified on hardware)
dashboard_change: Removed bottom RSS runner and market panel; 4-panel grade layouts
dashboard_test_status: Xvfb navigation and no-news/no-market regression passed
native_file_dialogs: EIDOLITH uses OS dialog: GTK/KDE on Linux; Explorer-style on Windows; platform fallback Tk
